en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 7. `Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn `Imran al-Daqqaq (RA) said: Muhammad ibn Ya`qub said: `Ali ibn Ibrahim said, on the authority of Muhammad ibn `Isa, on the authority of Yunus ibn `Abd al-Rahman, on the authority of Malik al-Juhani that Abu `Abd Allah al-Sadiq (AS) said: “
If people knew what reward there is in speaking about the Appearance they would never cease speaking about it.”
